brief:
The Trump administration has approved a $2.8 billion arms deal for Israel that includes 40,000 bombs, Drop Site News reported. The sale marks one of several military aid packages the U.S. has authorized for Israel in recent months.

A building collapse in Gaza has killed at least 21 people, according to reports. The cause of the collapse was not immediately determined.

U.S. diesel prices have climbed above $6.30 per gallon, reflecting broader fuel cost pressures across the American economy.
title: Trump administration approves $2.8 billion arms package for Israel
